Counsel for the Petitioner(S):
 1. Venkata Subbaiah Pogula
Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. Chaudhary And Chaudhary Advocates And Solicitors

2. G.Arun Showri(Central Govt. Cousel)
 3. Gp For Land Acquisition (Ap)

The Court made the following:
ORDER:
-
1. This Writ petition is filed claiming the following relief:

"...To issue a writ, order or direction, particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring that 3-A notification issued vide S.O.2067(E) dated 23.05.2018 and 3-D notification issued vide S.O.4295(E), dated 04.09.2018 has lapsed by virtue of Section 25 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 read with RFCTLARR ( R e m o v a l o f D i f f i c u l t i e s ) O r d e r , 2 0 1 5 ; ( b ) d e c l a r e t h e n o t i c e Roc.No.NHAI/Dt/1157/2017, dated .11.2023 issued under Section 3-E(1) & 3H(2) &
(4) of National Highways Act, 1956 issued for handing over possession of lands admeasuring 675.343 Sq.Mtrs in Sy.No.260/1B of Budumullauvaripalle Village, Piler Mandal, Annamayya District belong to the 1st petitioner; and 67.450 Sq.Mtrs in Sy.No.260/1B of Budumullavaripalle Village, Piler Mandal, Annamayya District as illegal, arbitrary, violative of principles of natural justice and violative rights guaranteed under Article 300 A of the constitution of India and set aside the same;
and (c) pass such other orders..."
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the Respondents.

sentences.text: But, after verification, it was found that the award was already passed under Section 3D of the National Highways Act, 1956 and the award amount has already been deposited with Respondent No.2 herein.

4. Learned counsel further submits that Respondent No.2 issued the Notices/proceedings to the petitioners for disbursement of the said award amount, after satisfaction of Respondent No.2 regarding title over the subject property which was acquired admeasuring to an extent of 675.343 Sq.Mtrs and to an extent of 67.450 Sq.Mtrs in Sy.No.260/1B of Budumullauvaripalle Village, Piler Mandal, Annamayya District.

5. On the other hand, Learned Standing Counsel for Respondent No.3 submits that Respondent No.2 already determined the total compensation to be paid and the award was passed and also the entire awarded amount already determined by Respondent No.2 was deposited for disbursal of the same in favour of the persons, who entitled to receive the same.
If the petitioners submit their title proof, Respondent No.2 will disburse Award amount in respect of each petitioner.

6. Having regard to the submissions made by both the counsels, this Court is of the considered view that the present writ petition can be disposed of, directing the petitioners to approach the Respondent No.2 and prove their respective title by submitting the required documents before Respondent No.2 within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Upon such submission of required documents by the petitioners, Respondent No.2 shall consider and pass appropriate orders within a period of four weeks thereafter.
7. With the above-said direction, the writ petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.

__ JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA 6th November, 2024 Knr HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA 6th November, 2024 Knr B C Amarnath Reddy vs Union Of India on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47749029/
